alternatives.name: Exchange fund
alternatives.note: Contribute the shares to a partnership of other holders' stock; after ~7 years you redeem a diversified basket with your original basis carried over. No tax on contribution, illiquid, accredited/qualified-purchaser only, fees ~0.5–1%/yr. Diversifies the idiosyncratic risk without a sale.

alternatives.name: Variable prepaid forward (VPF)
alternatives.note: A dealer pays ~75–90% of the value today against delivery of a variable number of shares in 2–5 years — economically the collar-loan row above in one OTC contract. Rev. Rul. 2003-7 conditions apply; minimums are usually $1M+.

alternatives.name: Charitable remainder trust / donor-advised fund
alternatives.note: Gifting appreciated shares removes the embedded gain entirely (and earns a deduction); a CRT returns an income stream. Only if a charitable goal exists.

alternatives.name: Direct indexing + loss harvesting
alternatives.note: Build an index sleeve as individual stocks and harvest their losses to offset gains realised by trimming the concentrated position a little each year.
